Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive urine culture for >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and mild proteinuria are noted. Glucosuria is present without ketones, which may suggest hyperglycemia. Low specific gravity may indicate dilute urine. Recommend clinical correlation for UTI symptoms and consideration of diabetes screening.
